items.example: Hey, long time no see! How are things?

items.phrase: What have you been up to?
items.example: I haven't seen you for ages! What have you been up to?
'What are you doing?' 'Not much, just relaxing.'
I'm fine, thanks. What about you?

items.phrase: Spend time with family and friends
items.translation: Проводи время с семьёй и друзьями
items.example: One of the best ways to feel happy is to spend time with family and friends.

items.phrase: What do you do that really interests you?
items.translation: Чем ты занимаешься, что тебе действительно интересно?
items.example: What do you do that really interests you in your free time?

items.phrase: When did you last learn something new?
items.translation: Когда ты в последний раз учил что-то новое?
items.example: When did you last learn something new? I started guitar lessons last month.
